title: Alien wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,10 30,40 70,40' fill='#ff4fa3'/>
  <polygon points='50,10 42,26 58,26' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <polygon points='42,26 38,34 62,34 58,26' fill='#4fd2ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='9' r='4' fill='#ffe95c'/>
  <!-- hat band -->
  <polygon points='30,40 70,40 68,45 32,45' fill='#8a5cff'/>
  <!-- alien head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='28' ry='24' fill='#6fe36f'/>
  <!-- head shine -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='52' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#a6f5a6'/>
  <!-- eye stalks -->
  <rect x='36' y='30' width='5' height='12' rx='2.5' fill='#4fc44f'/>
  <rect x='59' y='30' width='5' height='12' rx='2.5' fill='#4fc44f'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='38.5' cy='30' r='9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61.5' cy='30' r='9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='38.5' cy='30' r='4.5' fill='#2b1e6b'/>
  <circle cx='61.5' cy='30' r='4.5' fill='#2b1e6b'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M40 70 Q50 80 60 70' stroke='#2b8a2b' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='66' r='4' fill='#ff9ecf'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='66' r='4' fill='#ff9ecf'/>
  <!-- antennae dots -->
  <circle cx='38.5' cy='20' r='2.5' fill='#ffe95c'/>
  <circle cx='61.5' cy='20' r='2.5' fill='#ffe95c'/>
</svg>
